name: vibesdk-csrf
description: Double-submit-cookie CSRF protection, ported from worker/services/csrf/CsrfService.ts, shared by every aws/*-lambda that has non-GET routes reachable via the ambient accessToken cookie (auth-api, apps-api, user-api, github-export). A real crypto-sensitive comparison, not duplicated per-Lambda the way small stateless helpers (response.ts, fake-dynamo.ts) are elsewhere in this migration. Not part of the main vibesdk build.
